Meta accepts MP4, MOV or GIF; TikTok accepts MPEG-2 or MPEG-4, so a single MP4 satisfies both. TikTok crops device edges, so key elements must stay centred. The iHeart deck lists TikTok at 540×960; 1080×1920 is the same ratio at 2x and is accepted.
